versions.changelog:
Initial release of GitToQuark: an automated assistant to save GitHub repositories to Quark Cloud Drive with location-aware proxy support.

- Supports downloading both source archives and release assets from public GitHub repositories.
- Automatically detects user geolocation to select appropriate CDN/proxy routing for users in China.
- Requires and manages Quark Cloud Drive CLI authorization, including automated install and login flow.
- Parses user input for repo URLs and intelligently decides between source and release modes.
- Handles errors for repo not found, no release, asset match failures, proxy issues, and more.
- Provides clear stepwise flows for download, upload, and cleanup, with default and customizable paths.
